$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: diagnostic_ions
title: diagnostic_ions.tsv
description: One row per configured diagnostic ion found in a raw MS2 spectrum, in file order. Written only when `diagnostic_ions` is enabled.

fields.name: scannr
fields.description: Native spectrum identifier, as in the `scannr` column of results.sage.parquet.

fields.name: mz
fields.description: Observed m/z of the matched peak, four decimals.

fields.name: relative_intensity
fields.description: Matched peak intensity divided by the spectrum's summed intensity (0-1], six decimals.
